description: Authorized Scrutiny Officer verifies submitted documents, land titles, building norms, faculty roster, and statutory certificates against APH standards.
aphClauseCitation: APH 2024-2027 Chapter I Cl. 1.5, 1.6 & Chapter II Table 2.3

entryPrerequisites.description: Case must be assigned to the evaluating Scrutiny Officer.

validationRules: All scrutiny checklist items must be marked COMPLIANT
Scrutiny clearance summary sheet signed by officer must be uploaded

allowedTransitions.buttonLabel: Clear Scrutiny & Forward for Approval (EVC Exempt)
validationRules: Allowed only where APH explicitly exempts physical inspection (e.g., NBA accredited course addition)
All scrutiny checklist items must be marked COMPLIANT
At least 1 itemized deficiency must be logged with clause citation and remediation instructions
A formal Deficiency Memo must be generated

timePolicy.description: Scrutiny SLA: Scrutiny Officer must complete evaluation within 5 working days of assignment.

exitConditions.description: Scrutiny report or deficiency memo recorded.
verificationCriteria: Every document item evaluated as Compliant or Deficient
Digital signature of Scrutiny Officer captured
